<thought>Since searching with generic “halide” and “ketones” returned no templates, I will try the more specific functional group names that are available: “aryl halide” for the broken group and “ketones” for the formed group. This should locate the Friedel‑Crafts acylation template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CCl)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
    "limit": 10
}
</action_input>
